title: AMA: I spent eight months investigating the cybersecurity bootcamp IronCircle (formerly ThriveDX)
content_md:
I'm an investigative reporter with The Hechinger Report, a national education news site. I've spent much of this year looking into the for-profit cybersecurity bootcamp IronCircle (formerly ThriveDX and HackerUSA.) You can read my story here: https://hechingerreport.org/a-university-branded-boot-camp-promised-tech-jobs-it-delivered-only-debt/ Over the course of my reporting, IronCircle was first acquired by another company and then shut down with no warning for students. I spoke with more than 35 former students and employees, as well as reviewed hundreds of pages of records from universities and email communications. I'd love to answer questions anyone might have about my reporting process and my findings. submitted by /u/Hechinger_Sarah [link] [comments]
